source_text: De duabus semis tribubus et novem semis tribubus. Moyses hereditatem terrae distribuit trans Iordanen duabus semis tribubus — tribui Ruben et tribui Gad et dimidiae tribui Manasse. Reliquis tribubus non Moyses sed Iesus dividit terram. Pactum tamen initum est ut relictis mulieribus et infantibus ipsi cum fratribus pugnent donec et ipsi hereditatem consequantur. Post obitum Moysi Iesus promissa deposcit. Haec historiae textus; nos conversi ad Dominum qui aufert velamen ex lectione veteris Testamenti figuraliter illis accidentia propter nos scripta esse sentimus, in quos fines saeculorum devenerunt. Adscendamus a littera ad spiritum.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning two half-tribes and nine half-tribes. Moses inheritance of-land distributed across Jordan to-two half-tribes — to-tribe Reuben and to-tribe Gad and to-half tribe Manasseh. To-remaining tribes not Moses but Jesus divides land. Covenant however entered-is that with-women-left and infants themselves with brothers they-fight until also themselves inheritance they-obtain. After death of-Moses Jesus promises demands. These of-history text; we turned unto Lord who takes-away veil from reading of-old Testament figuratively to-them happening-things on-account-of us written to-be we-perceive, unto whom ends of-ages have-come. Let-us-ascend from letter unto spirit.
pass_b_english: On the two and a half tribes and the nine and a half. [[Moses allotted land east of the Jordan to the two and a half tribes — Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh >> Bible:Joshua 13:8]]. To the rest not Moses but Jesus divides the land. Yet a covenant was struck: leaving women and little ones behind, the fighting men would help their brothers until those too received their inheritance. After Moses’ death Jesus presses the promise. So much for the history; we who have turned to the Lord, who [[removes the veil from the reading of the old covenant >> Bible:2 Corinthians 3:14-16]], know that [[these things happened figuratively to them and were written for us, on whom the ends of the ages have come >> Bible:1 Corinthians 10:11]]. Let us rise from letter to spirit.
